parameters.name: RepoNamespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs.

parameters.name: RepoType
parameters.description:
The type of the repository. Valid values:

*   `PUBLIC`: a public repository.
*   `PRIVATE`: a private repository.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-chart-repository --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-type PUBLIC --summary test --repo-namespace-name test --repo-name test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateChartRepository --region cn-hangzhou --RepoNamespaceName test --RepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --RepoName test --Summary test
